summary: This completed study tested a 12-week food and lifestyle program called the SWW Method for women aged 35 to 75. Researchers looked at how the program affected body weight, body mass index, and blood sugar levels over 12 weeks. Sarah Wragge Wellness sponsored the trial, which included 85 participants. The main goal was to see if these changes could help prevent conditions like type 2 diabetes and metabolic syndrome.
